pr_title: Continue on template error during yaml import for generic
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
During yaml import for generic (camera), a check is done on the still_image_url.  But the check can fail if this url contains a template referring to an entity which is not yet initialized at that point in the startup.

This change is to allow `TemplateError`s to occur during yaml import, on the assumption that the original yaml was valid.

If it turns out to be invalid after all, it is not a huge problem.  The user can still tinker with it in the configuration section of the UI, and the checks will be done (the errors are only ignored during yaml import).

issue_context.title: YAML import can fail if there are templates in still_image_url for generic
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Steps to reproduce:

1. Start home assistant
2. Add the ISS integration via the web interface
3. Add the following to `configuration.yaml`:
````
camera:
  - platform: generic
    name: ISS
    still_image_url: http://static-maps.yandex.ru/1.x/?lang=en-US&ll={{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }}&size=650,450&z=3&l=sat,skl&pt=9.955727,49.821417,flag~-49.94082957,41.72583043,flag~{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }},pmyws
    limit_refetch_to_url_change: true
````

What I expected to happen:

- yaml config imports successfully
- generic camera is visible in integrations page

What actually happened
````
2022-04-06 09:23:35 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.camera] Loading generic IP camera via configuration.yaml is deprecated, it will be automatically imported.  Once you have confirmed correct operation, please remove 'generic' (IP camera) section(s) from configuration.yaml
2022-04-06 09:23:35 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.binary_sensor] Setting up binary_sensor.iss
2022-04-06 09:23:35 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.helpers.template] Template variable error: 'None' has no attribute 'attributes' when rendering 'http://static-maps.yandex.ru/1.x/?lang=en-US&ll={{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }}&size=650,450&z=3&l=sat,skl&pt=9.955727,49.821417,flag~-49.94082957,41.72583043,flag~{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }},pmyws'
2022-04-06 09:23:35 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.config_flow] Error parsing template Template("http://static-maps.yandex.ru/1.x/?lang=en-US&ll={{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }}&size=650,450&z=3&l=sat,skl&pt=9.955727,49.821417,flag~-49.94082957,41.72583043,flag~{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }},pmyws"): UndefinedError: 'None' has no attribute 'attributes'
2022-04-06 09:23:35 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.config_flow] Error importing generic IP camera platform config: unexpected error '['template_error']'
````
- After this the generic camera is not visible in the integrations page.

It appears that the generic integration is starting before the templates/other entities are ready.

I assume this can be solved by changing a dependency.

Thanks to @VDRainer for finding this in issue #69273

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.5.0.dev0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

generic

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
camera:
  - platform: generic
    name: ISS
    still_image_url: http://static-maps.yandex.ru/1.x/?lang=en-US&ll={{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }}&size=650,450&z=3&l=sat,skl&pt=9.955727,49.821417,flag~-49.94082957,41.72583043,flag~{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.long }},{{ states.binary_sensor.iss.attributes.lat }},pmyws
    limit_refetch_to_url_change: true
```

comments: @frenck I am not sure how to solve this.  Is there a way of deferring  this integration at startup, to wait until templates can be rendered?  I couldn't find other integrations that needed to do this.
There is no way to differing this.

Hmm... 

I thought that maybe manifest.json `"after_dependencies": xxx` might be able to do it.  But it doesn't seem to work how I thought.

Perhaps an alternative is to catch the template error, then retry after a time delay.  Feels a bit hacky though.  Are there other situations where one integration must wait for others?

This is not about after depencies. The entity referenced can be unavailable, not loaded yet, removed or anything else.

IMHO, the camera should become unavailable until it can be rendered

I have created the above PR which essentially ignores any TemplateErrors during yaml import.  It means that if the user had errors in their yaml, they will remain and will need to be fixed manually after the import.  This solution seems ok to me because template errors are much easier/quicker to fix in the UI.

I am still having an issue when I try to import my camera or add it manually via the generic camera integration UI. These same cameras worked fine in 2022.3.8.

Error in UI
```
Authorisation failed while trying to connect to stream
```

Error in logs
```
2022-04-08 11:00:47 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.config_flow] Error getting camera image from https://supersecrethaurl.comNone: ConnectError
2022-04-08 11:00:47 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.config_flow] Error getting camera image from https://supersecrethaurl.comNone: ConnectError
2022-04-08 11:00:48 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.config_flow] Error getting camera image from https://supersecrethaurl.comNone: ConnectError
2022-04-08 11:00:53 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.generic.config_flow] Error importing generic IP camera platform config: unexpected error '['unable_still_load']'
```

@broyuken Do you have any templates in your urls? If not you probably have a different issue?  The log looks like an authentication failure for the stream.

Please paste a copy of your YAML to help narrow down.

I do use templates in the still image url. And the error shows right above the stream url, even though I can use that stream url in VLC and it works fine, and it worked in 2022.3.8 as well. This only became an issue after upgrading to 2022.4 and 4.1

```
camera:
  - platform: generic
    name: Driveway Camera
    still_image_url: https://supersecrethaurl{{ state_attr('camera.driveway_camera_snapshot', 'entity_picture') }}
    stream_source: rtsp://username:password@supersecrethaurl:8554/780473d4e513_live
```

@broyuken Please can you describe step by step what you did and the UI messages + logs you saw? You have described a YAML import error and a UI message, but those are generated by two different actions.

I suggest trying in the UI still image only, then stream only, to separate the two errors.
I was able to fix it, I had to put the authentication in the rtsp url instead of in the username/password boxes. Then it worked fine.
@broyuken Yes, this is a known issue #69684.

review_comments: Why do we even care if the template renders to something valid? We can just import it and the errors will show up when it tries to render the initialized entity.

For YAML import I don't think it matters to ignore it. For when a user just typed it in the UI, my aim was to tell them if it was invalid with a UI message (so they can see the error on the UI rather than having to watch the log).
